summary: REQ-1 appears implemented: the MonthlyVolumeSummary component now only aggregates and conditionally renders “Total Reps” and “Total Time”, with no “Total Volume” label/value block present. Two additional non-product files were also modified (project_state.json and frontend-file-summaries.txt), which were not requested by the BuildRequest.
